gloss: hiring through personal connections; nepotistic hiring

definitions.gloss: hiring through personal connections; recruitment by referral
definitions.explanation: Employing someone on the strength of a family tie or personal introduction rather than an open selection process. The word is broadly neutral in business usage but often carries a critical edge.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{縁故|えんこ}{採用|さいよう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: That company does a lot of hiring through personal connections.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{縁故|えんこ}{採用|さいよう}⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧、⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けて→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: He didn't get in through connections; he took the exam.

examples.japanese: {縁故|えんこ}{採用|さいよう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{組織|そしき}→組織：03320_soshiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{発想|はっそう}→発想：04309_hassou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}り→入る：00494_hairu⟧にくく⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: When hiring through connections continues, it becomes hard for fresh ideas to enter an organization.

notes:
{縁故|えんこ} means a personal or family connection; ⟦{採用|さいよう}→採用：04563_saiyou⟧ means hiring. Small firms often use the practice openly, while at large companies and public bodies the word implies unfairness.

- {縁故|えんこ}{採用|さいよう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{入社|にゅうしゃ}する→入社する：25409_nyuushasuru⟧: to join a company through connections
- {縁故|えんこ}{採用|さいよう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{廃止|はいし}→廃止：12483_haishi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to abolish hiring by connection
- {縁故|えんこ}{採用|さいよう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{疑|うたが}われる→疑う：01889_utagau⟧: to be suspected of nepotistic hiring

SIMILAR WORDS:
